en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of fantasy will Gonta have?
Something heartwarming, perhaps?

Thank you for coming to see Gonta. Gonta will
do best to be Shuichi's companion.
...What? Ah, okay...

Hungry? Need Gonta to carry your luggage?
Gonta is plenty strong.

Ah, no, I didn't bring anything with me...
What...is going on here, exactly?

What you mean? Is normal for gentleman
to be gentle with woman.
...A woman. Ah.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose I'm meant
to play a woman...

<CLT=cltMIND>I know I'm supposed to be a good partner,
but this is going to be difficult.
...Oh, you don't like it?

You right... Gonta shouldn't force Shuichi into
lady role, just for practice party...
Huh? Am I not supposed to be a lady...?
Huh? You're not a woman, are you?

Wait, is Shuichi really woman!? S-Sorry!
Gonta should've noticed sooner!
Ah, n-no no, I'm a man!

Oh, okay. Good... Gonta wouldn't know what
to do if Gonta upset Shuichi on accident.

Ah, don't worry about that...
Harmless mistake.

You want to practice for the part, right?
Well, I'm happy to help you.

Shuichi is so nice. Gonta wishes he could
return favor somehow...
Oh yeah! Practice on Gonta!
And by practice, you mean...

Gonta's never behaved like lady before.
But Gonta will do his best if you'll let him.
Ah! Y-You don't have to go *that* far, Gonta!

B-But what Gonta supposed to do!?
Shuichi being so nice to Gonta!

Gonta, it's alright! Really, it's
fine...just settle down.
Hey, what should Gonta do!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta grabbed my shoulders hard.
I couldn't handle the weight, and...
Ah! Whoa!

<CLT=cltMIND>We fell onto the bed behind us,
limbs entangled.
Ah... Um...

<CLT=cltMIND>I had fallen on my back, and Gonta
was right above me, breathing hard.

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't move. Gonta's massive body on top
of mine was too intimidating.
A-Aghhhhhhh!
Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta's body jerked upward as if pulled by
some unseen force, jumping back a few feet.
Gonta? Are you okay?

Gonta's not okay! Not okay at all!
How could Gonta...do this!?

Ah, Gonta, don't worry about it!
You surprised me a little, that's all...

Gonta does worry! Is unforgiveable for
gentleman to mistreat lady!
<CLT=cltMIND>So I'm still playing the lady, huh?

No, even if Shuichi not lady...
Is still bad.

Gonta scared Shuichi... Still long way to go
before Gonta can be gentleman.

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta...
You noticed that I was a little scared...

You might not believe Gonta, but...
Gonta not ever wanna hurt you.
Yeah...I know.

<CLT=cltMIND>I stood and walked up to him.
I could see his shoulders trembling.

Hey, I'm just fine, okay?
Let's keep practicing for the party.
Sh-Shuichi... Thank you!

Gonta be perfect companion this time.
Gonta...take care of you.
Thank you, Gonta.

<CLT=cltMIND>Inspired by Gonta's impeccable manners,
I reciprocated and offered my hand.

<CLT=cltMIND>He may not look the part, but I am convinced
Gonta is polite and kind. A gentleman.
Ummm... What would gentleman say?
Gonta keep you up all night!

That...might not be...
completely accurate...
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
